Method of Attack: Creates ransom note DECRYPTING.txt demanding 0.1 BTC payment
Requires victim to open Remote Desktop Services and send admin credentials to attacker
Attacker may decrypt files but also install malware, delete files, or steal data
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with Remote Desktop Services
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection leading to file encryption and remote desktop compromise
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin address 1CnCfvUTFQf11QNeBEpk29rRXfNFg75R9n linked to mixing activity
